name: Mount Takao by Trail 1
region: Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park
why: An hour from Tokyo: a paved path past the Yakuo-in temple and its tengu statues to a summit with Mount Fuji over the ridges.
book: Free. Keio line to Takaosanguchi; cable car for part of the way.
water: Shops and teahouses on the way.
dangers: Very crowded at weekends in November.

points.name: Takaosanguchi
points.note: The station at the foot of the mountain.

points.name: Yakuo-in
points.note: A mountain temple with tengu statues.

points.name: Mount Takao
points.note: The 599 m summit with the view of Fuji.
